cells.gap: No instrument. The DFSA's 41 "Single Family Office" entries are ALL withdrawn — DIFC moved single-family offices to the Family Wealth Centre in 2023, which publishes no public register. A zero in this cell is therefore not a statement about the market: the Gulf's family-office population is real and largely unlisted. Closing it needs a non-register instrument (directories, events, referral), not a better register.

Banque du Liban publishes no machine-readable list of licensed banks. Our 16 Lebanese records are held and deliberately frozen pending Law 23/2025 restructuring — which banks are on the survivor track is a question for Andre, not something to infer. This market is relationship-driven and saying so plainly is what makes the rest of our numbers trustworthy.

cells.gap: No register can close this cell. A single-family office is not a licensed activity in France, so it appears on no regulator's list by construction. The registry is the only instrument, and it proposes rather than proves — which is why these arrive as scored candidates for a human.
